scope: Client portfolio concept for a local demonstration. Source archived on GitHub at the repository owner's request; no production website deployed. Public covers downloaded through the browser's normal media download. No authentication or platform restriction bypass. Third-party media rights remain with their respective owners.
limitations: Original posts and reel footage require Instagram login. No original video footage acquired. The local studio-cover-edit.mp4 is an explicitly labelled concept motion composition made from the original cover images. Covers are 360/361 x 640. No complete case studies or verified results are claimed.
